name: Scallop Bisque with Carrots, Celery, Tomatoes, Parsley & Crispy Bacon

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the bowl with the veggies (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sea scallops
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon to a clean, paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)

Return pot with drippings to medium-high heat. Working in batches if necessary, add scallops in a single layer; cook until golden brown and opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, add to the plate with the bacon. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)
Return pot with drippings to medium heat. Add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7-8 minutes.
Add flour to the pot with the veggies and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes.
Slowly add broth to the pot, while stirring constantly, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, chop scallops into bite-sized pieces.
Add tomatoes, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine the soup and remove from heat. Purée with an immersion or regular blender (return soup to the pot).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls; top with scallops, bacon, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
